# NM Research

> NM Research is the research division of the NM Group of Industries and Research
> Foundation — a globally recognised research ecosystem headquartered in Kerala,
> India. We empower the next generation of scientists through research services,
> publication support, PhD assistance and global conferences, operating across
> India, USA, UK, Canada, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, Singapore and Japan.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/): The front gate of NM Research — mission, positioning, founding stats, the five-company group and the six-stage research pipeline (RESEARCH → EXPERIMENT → PROTOTYPE → VALIDATION → DEPLOYMENT → IMPACT).
- [About](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/about): The organisation — vision, mission, core values, global collaborations, news and updates, global footprint and a cinematic profile of the founder, Dr. Mathivanan Nallathambi.
- [Services](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/services): The end-to-end service catalogue mapped onto a single documented, reproducible workflow, plus internships, mentorship, workshops and innovation programs.
- [Research](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/research): The searchable research index — 11 domains and 250+ supported subjects, from topic framing to publication, plus research publishing and intellectual property support.
- [Companies](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/companies): The NM Group of Industries and Research Foundation — five associated companies spanning startup consulting, scholarly publishing, technology programs, drone technology and healthcare innovation.
- [Careers](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/careers): Career opportunities and internships across research, technology, business, healthcare, engineering and publications.
- [Privacy & Cookie Policy](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/privacy): How personal information is collected and used, and how visitors can accept all cookies or continue with essential cookies only.
- [Membership](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/membership): Annual membership tiers — Community, Platinum and Prime — unlocking publications, conferences and mentorship.
- [Contact](https://nmresearch.co.in/#/contact): Direct contact, researcher registration and the community join flow.

## Group Companies

- NM Association Pvt. Ltd.: Startup development, business consulting, entrepreneurship support and professional business solutions.
- Twin Dolphin Publications Pvt. Ltd.: Research publications, research books, scholarly publishing and patent-related documentation.
- NM Tech Intent Pvt. Ltd.: Conferences, workshops, internships, mentorship and educational programs.
- NM Drone Tech Pvt. Ltd.: Drone technology, sustainable agriculture, precision farming and crop protection.
- Clyra: Healthcare and pharmaceutical innovation, patient-oriented services and therapeutic research.

## Programs & Careers

- Internships: Practical exposure and supervised learning opportunities for eligible students.
- Research Mentorship: Guidance in research planning, methodology and scientific communication.
- Workshops & Conferences: Knowledge-sharing events, training programs and professional development.
- Innovation Programs: Hackathons, idea development and entrepreneurship initiatives.
- Careers: Research and scientific professionals, technology and engineering professionals, business development, startup and project management, and leadership roles.

## Privacy & Cookies

- Essential cookies and local storage: Required for site functionality, security and remembering the visitor's cookie choice.
- Optional cookies: Analytics cookies are used only with consent. The site does not currently use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
- Consent choices: Visitors can accept all cookies or continue with essential cookies only. The choice can be changed at any time via Cookie Settings in the footer or on the privacy page.
- Privacy contact: hello.nmassociation@gmail.com.

## Services

- Research Paper Writing: Crafting original research papers and review articles, methodology design, editing, formatting and plagiarism checks.
- Publication Support: Guidance for publishing in SCI, SCIE, Scopus, Web of Science and UGC CARE listed journals, including reviewer response support.
- PhD Assistance: Comprehensive doctoral support from topic selection and synopsis to thesis writing and defence preparation.
- Research Consulting: Free initial topic guidance, personalised roadmaps with domain experts, and book publication guidance.
- Analytical Services: Advanced characterisation (XRD, SEM, TEM, FTIR, UV-Vis, BET, EIS, XPS) and certified analytical reporting.
- Global Conferences: International and national conference organisation, workshops, webinars and researcher networking.

## Research Domains

- Chemistry & Materials Science: nanotechnology, nanoscience, material science, polymer science, catalysis and more.
- Biomedical & Life Sciences: biomedical science, biotechnology, microbiology, genetics, pharmacology, clinical research.
- Environmental & Energy Sciences: environmental science, wastewater treatment, climate change, renewables.
- Agricultural & Food Sciences: agricultural science, plant biotechnology, food technology, precision agriculture.
- Engineering & Technology: AI, machine learning, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, robotics, ECE, mech and civil.
- Energy Storage & Electrochemistry: batteries, supercapacitors, fuel cells and electrochemistry.
- Physics, Mathematics & Data: physics, quantum, applied mathematics, statistics and data analytics.
- Management & Business Sciences: innovation management, finance, marketing, business analytics, leadership.
- Social Sciences & Humanities: psychology, education, scientific writing, research methodology, public policy.
- Law, IP & Entrepreneurship: patents, IPR, technology transfer and innovation policy.
- Publication & Academic Support: SCI/SCIE/Scopus/UGC CARE publishing, patents, grants, editing and citation management.

## Key Facts

- 500+ SCI / Scopus publications
- 150+ academic & industry partners
- 15+ years of research excellence
- 8 countries of operation
- 11 research domains and 250+ supported subjects
- Slogan: "Innovate. Research. Publish. Impact."
